title: Use shared MakeMe and page-object guidance

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-329#use-shared-test-guidance

Verdict: Confirmed missing test path.

Story and revision: SEED-329#use-shared-test-guidance (.planning/seeds/SEED-329-use-shared-test-guidance.md#use-shared-test-guidance), plan .planning/slice-plans/603-use-shared-test-guidance/PLAN.md, implementation revision c1800ab36079b671a574b0ed3d18cd517b742695 (HEAD e2949c99f adds only the execution-complete record; the probe ran at c1800ab36).

Promise (key example 3 / scope): runner-scheduled Node tests under tests/*.test.mjs and tests/support/*.test.mjs match the `tests` Intent entry in this repository's .planning/open-dough.json alongside its shell checks, so MakeMe is selected, page objects stay off, and Intent keeps shell/JavaScript syntax per file. I used the caller's suggested promise, fault and focused command unchanged.

Fault: in .planning/open-dough.json, the `tests` location was replaced with {"path":"tests","kind":"shell","include":["*.sh"],"makeMe":true} (the pre-story legacy declaration). Fixtures and assertions were untouched. Rewriting the file also reflowed the other entries' one-element `include` arrays onto several lines. That change is whitespace only, so it does not change what they select.

Independent witness (scratch, against the checkout's own config): (a) the installed selector `node .agents/skills/dough-execute-plan/scripts/test-entry-rules.mjs --project "$PWD" --source tests/makeme-selection.test.mjs --source tests/support/repository-description.test.mjs --source tests/install.sh`; (b) Intent's matcher `sourceEntryOfRepositoryPath(path, testsLocation)` from src/skills/dough-makeme/scripts/intent-location-selection.mjs.
- Baseline: all three sources had makeMe true and pageObjects false. The matcher gave the shell hint for tests/install.sh and the javascript hint for both Node examples.
- Faulted: tests/makeme-selection.test.mjs and tests/support/repository-description.test.mjs dropped to makeMe false, and the matcher returned null for both (no entry, so no syntax hint). tests/install.sh stayed makeMe true with the shell hint. This shows the promise breaks on the intended path.

Maintained checks examined: the focused command `PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" npm test -- tests/makeme-selection.test.mjs tests/makeme-selection-configuration.test.mjs tests/support/test-entry-rules.test.mjs tests/support/test-entry-rules-compatibility.test.mjs`. I ran it with OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_OUTCOMES and OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_TIMES to show that every job ran.
- Baseline: exit 0, with all 4 jobs recorded as passed.
- Faulted: exit 0, with all 4 jobs passed. Each check builds its own fixture project (materializeSelectionProject / intentSettingsForLocations and similar), so none reads this repository's .planning/open-dough.json.
- Bounded search for other readers: `git grep` for open-dough.json across tests/, dashboard test trees, src skill tests, scripts/ and .github/. Every hit writes or reads a fixture project's config, or checks installer preservation. No hit loads the repository's own `tests` entry. scripts/ and .github/ have no reader. I ran no broader suite, so this finding covers only the examined checks and that search, not the whole suite.

Omitted transition: no maintained check joins this repository's real tests/node-test-files globs (and tests/*.sh) to its own .planning/open-dough.json and confirms that every scheduled source still selects MakeMe, with the expected syntax hint. Reverting the declaration therefore passes silently.

Next proof action: add journey proof for that omitted transition. For example, a check that expands the real tests/node-test-files and tests/*.sh globs, runs the installed selector against this repository's own configuration, and asserts makeMe true and pageObjects false for each source. Optionally it can also assert the `tests` entry's shell and javascript hints.

Prior disposition: this matches the plan's own "Execution complete" product advice. It already notes that no maintained check ties tests/node-test-files globs or tests/*.sh to a MakeMe-enabled entry and suggests such a check. The probe confirms that advice with a faulted observation. It does not make a new repair decision; test repair and follow-up routing stay with the caller.

Restoration: a trap restored the saved original config. The post-probe `git status --porcelain` matched the empty pre-probe state, `git diff --quiet HEAD` passed, and `cmp` showed the config byte-identical. The witness returned baseline results again. The rerun focused command exited 0 with all 4 jobs passed. The scratch worktree at /tmp/intent-cov-329.0ek1/wt was then removed. The working checkout at /Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.worktrees/use-shared-makeme-and-page-object-guidance was not modified, stashed, committed or pushed, and still has a clean status at e2949c99f.

Costs:
- Test runtime: measured wall-clock around each npm test invocation in the scratch worktree. Baseline about 8.3 s on the first run and 7.6 s on the outcome-recording run (cold start). Faulted about 2.1 s. Restored about 2.0 s. Per-job times from the runner: 1.8–6.8 s for makeme-selection-configuration, about 1.0–4.0 s for makeme-selection, 0.8–3.7 s for compatibility, and 0.1–0.6 s for test-entry-rules. Excludes `node scripts/setup-native.mjs npm` (not timed).
- Human effort: unavailable. There was no human interaction during the check, and no separate measure was available.
- Agent effort: unavailable as a measured figure. Basis: about 25 tool operations, counted from this session. That count is an estimate of activity, not of time or tokens.

- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 147919 ms (measured), from 1794479284729 to 1794479432648 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

- Checked revision: c1800ab36079b671a574b0ed3d18cd517b742695.
- Evidence: scratch revert of the `tests` entry dropped MakeMe selection and syntax hints for runner-scheduled Node tests while the four maintained selection checks still passed.
- Decision: routine test strengthening; this is a protection gap, not a delivered defect (the delivered configuration selects correctly). Queued as a bounded correction, first in the Backlog list under the follow-up priority default (no retrospective follow-up exists).
- Follow-up: [Guard scheduled-test MakeMe selection](seeds/SEED-329-use-shared-test-guidance.md#guard-scheduled-test-makeme-selection) — SEED-329#guard-scheduled-test-makeme-selection, plan [605](slice-plans/605-guard-scheduled-test-makeme-selection/PLAN.md), recorded ready.
